import numpy as np

# Camera at (0,0).
# In obs_0007, heading is 270 deg.
# Target ray angle from heading:
# ray_angle = atan2(base_x7 - 256, 256) = atan2(351 - 256, 256) = atan2(95, 256) = +20.37 deg (to the right of 270)
# So bearing = 270 + 20.37 = 290.37 deg.
# In obs_0008, heading is 315 deg.
# base_x8:
import cv2
img8 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0008.png')
mask8 = (img8[:,:,2] > 120) & (img8[:,:,0] < 50)
y8, x8 = np.where(mask8)
base_x8 = (x8.min() + x8.max()) / 2
print('obs_0008 base_x8:', base_x8)
# ray_angle = atan2(base_x8 - 256, 256)
# Bearing from obs_0008 = 315 + atan2(base_x8 - 256, 256)
ray8 = np.degrees(np.arctan2(base_x8 - 256, 256))
print('obs_0008 ray offset:', ray8, 'Bearing:', 315 + ray8)
"
